sources.title: Montana Code Annotated 7-4-2104, Commissioners to be elected by district
sources.words: the election of the member or members of the board must be submitted to the entire electorate of the county unless otherwise provided for under: (a) a plan of government provided for in a county adopting an optional or alternative form of government; or (b) a court order

notes.lines: Every precinct line is the Secretary of State's table's, generalised by at most 1.5 metres and set on a grid of 0.00001 degree (about a metre); where two neighbours drew one line twice a few metres apart the two drawings were made one. A point within a few metres of a line can fall on either side of it.
notes.parts: The smallest area the Secretary's table names is a precinct part: a precinct cut wherever a district line crosses it. Each shape is one part, named by its precinct's name and its own number, and what is said of it is the table's own word for that part. Where the table leaves a district blank, the State Library's lines of that district stand in (check: filled_from_the_lines).
notes.whole_precincts: The parts do not yet cover every county whole. Where a precinct of the Library's precinct layer has 3% or more of its area (and at least 1 square kilometre) outside every part, the whole precinct is added to the county's file after the parts and marked whole, with the year of its lines (as_of): a point the parts cover is given the part; a point they do not cover is given the whole precinct, which says only what lines can tell.
notes.places: Montana has no townships. A part the table puts in a city or town is given that city or town (mcd); a part in open country names no place. Butte-Silver Bow and Anaconda-Deer Lodge are consolidated city-county governments.
notes.wards: A part's ward is the table's word, read as a number where the words give one (Ward 2, BILLINGS #2, WARD #2W in Whitefish); ward_said keeps the words themselves.
notes.commissioners: MCA 7-4-2104: a county commissioner must live in the district, and the whole county elects each one, unless the county's plan of government or a court order provides otherwise. So the commissioner districts are not voting areas and are not drawn; com_said keeps the table's words, and supervisor_plans says how each county elects (the two consolidated governments elect under their own charters and are left out). The county's election office is the authority.
notes.school: School district lines are the State Library's. Which districts a part lies in is analysis, not an official list: a district counts when its piece of the part is at least 60 metres thick somewhere; school_pct is each district's share of the part's area (land and water, not voters). An elementary district lies under a high school district, so a part is usually in both; school_said keeps the table's own words. No school office is on the November 2026 ballot (trustees are elected in May).
notes.authority: For which precinct an address votes in, and where, the county election administrator and the Montana Secretary of State's My Voter Page are the authority.
notes.precinct_ids: A part's id is its county's five digits and the table's name for the part (30063-UC95E-02); a whole precinct's is its county's five digits, WHOLE and the precinct's name.
notes.disclaimers: The Montana State Library asks that its limits travel with its data; they are under sources, word for word.

format.files: Every file is TopoJSON on one grid (transform above): arcs are delta-encoded lines; a shape's arcs name the lines of its rings, a negative number n meaning line ~n backwards; outer rings run counter-clockwise, holes clockwise.
format.county_files: precincts/<county>.json, object 'precincts': one shape per precinct part, then any whole precincts (whole: true). arcMask[i] has bit k set when line i is an outline of arc_kinds[k] (never on a whole precinct's lines); arcSides[2i] and arcSides[2i+1] are the shapes on the right and left of line i (-1: a shape in another county's file, one just across a gap in the drawing, or none; -2: outside Montana); names gives the names of the places the file's shapes lie in.
format.boxes: boxes[county] holds four whole numbers a shape, in the file's order: west, south, east, north in steps of box_step degrees from the transform's translate, rounded outwards. A point is tried against every shape whose box (widened by half a step) holds it, and given to the first that holds it.

precinct_properties.name: the precinct's name (UC 95 E, part 02): the Secretary's table's name for the precinct and the part's number
precinct_properties.precinct: the precinct's name in the Secretary's table
precinct_properties.part: the part's number in the table
precinct_properties.whole: true on a whole precinct added where the parts do not cover it
precinct_properties.as_of: on a whole precinct, the year its lines were last changed
precinct_properties.mcd: city or town (absent in open country)
precinct_properties.ward: list: the city ward the part lies in, where the table's words give its number
precinct_properties.psc: public service commissioner district (PSC1 1, PSC2 2, PSC3 3, PSC4 4, PSC5 5)
precinct_properties.split: on a part whose district the table leaves blank: each district's share in percent, where a second holds 3 percent or more
precinct_properties.school: list: the school districts the part lies in, elementary or K-12 first, largest share first, then any high school district
precinct_properties.school_pct: list, when the part is in more than one: each district's share of its area, in percent
precinct_properties.school_out: percent of the part's area that lies in no elementary or K-12 district (given from 3 percent up)
precinct_properties.school_edge: list: neighbouring districts that only brush the part along a line (try them too when placing a point)
precinct_properties.c: a point inside the part's largest piece, for a label: [longitude, latitude]
precinct_properties.city_said: the city or town district the table names, in its words
precinct_properties.ward_said: the ward the table names, in its words
precinct_properties.com_said: the county commissioner district the table names, in its words (where the commissioner must live; see supervisor_plans)
precinct_properties.school_said: the school districts the table names, in its words
precinct_properties.trustee_said: the school trustee district the table names
precinct_properties.swcd_said: the conservation district the table names
precinct_properties.hospital_said: the hospital district the table names
precinct_properties.fire_said: the fire district the table names
precinct_properties.water_said: the water or water and sewer district the table names
precinct_properties.sewer_said: the sewer district the table names
precinct_properties.park_said: the park district the table names
precinct_properties.library_said: the library district the table names
precinct_properties.cemetery_said: the cemetery district the table names
precinct_properties.ambulance_said: the ambulance district the table names
precinct_properties.mosquito_said: the mosquito district the table names
precinct_properties.resort_said: the resort area district the table names
precinct_properties.irrigation_said: the irrigation district the table names
precinct_properties.drainage_said: the drainage district the table names
precinct_properties.rural_said: the rural (outside a city) district the table names
precinct_properties.improvement_said: the rural improvement district the table names
precinct_properties.transit_said: the urban transportation district the table names
precinct_properties.study_said: the local government study commission district the table names
precinct_properties.special_said: the special district the table names
precinct_properties.court_said: the city or municipal court (jury) district the table names
precinct_properties.community_council_said: the community council district the table names

ids.every layer: a shape's properties j and d are the jurisdiction id and the district its races carry on the ballot pages
ids.mcd: MT-M- and the Census Bureau's place code (MT-M-61525); properties.t says city, town or consolidated city-county
ids.cd: the district (2); properties.race is the race for Congress
ids.school: MT-S- and the Office of Public Instruction's legal entity number (MT-S-0861); properties.t says elementary, high school or K-12, properties.nces the federal district code
